title: Melco Resorts Philippines Foundation donates P24.8M to equip new Philippine Red Cross Center
summary: Melco Resorts (Philippines) Foundation continues its support for the Philippine Red Cross (PRC) with a P24.8 million donation of medical and non-medical equipment for the new PRC Cavite Chapter…

blocks.text: Melco Resorts (Philippines) Foundation continues its support for the Philippine Red Cross (PRC) with a P24.8 million donation of medical and non-medical equipment for the new PRC Cavite Chapter headquarters and Provincial Blood Center at the Vermosa Complex in Imus, Cavite. The Foundation is the charitable arm of City of Dreams Manila. Clarence Chung, Chairman and President of Melco Resorts Philippines Foundation, led the ceremonial turnover of the donation to Philippine Red Cross Chairman and CEO Richard Gordon at City of Dreams Manila, together with Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) Chairman and CEO Alejandro Tengco. “We are grateful for the […]...
